## About
Rocket Movers is a locally owned and operated moving company based on E 7th St in Georgetown. Our climate controlled warehouse and dispatching facility sit right in the heart of town, and we move families and businesses around Georgetown and Central Texas.
Our crews are full-time movers, not day labor. We show up on time with enough people to get the job done quickly and carefully, and our price includes experienced movers and our modern moving equipment. Whether it's an apartment or a large estate, we'll match you with the right crew and trucks.
We're fully licensed and insured and a member of the Better Business Bureau. Customers are often so happy with their crew that they ask for the same crew on their next move.

## Services
- Residential and commercial moving: Home, apartment and office moves around Georgetown and Central Texas, with a crew and trucks sized to your move.
- Packing and crating: We pack and crate your belongings so they travel safely.
- Piano, antique and artwork moving: Extra care for pianos, antiques and artwork.
- Climate controlled storage: Our secure Georgetown warehouse is available for long or short term storage.
- White glove delivery: Delivery and installation of fine art, antiques and high end furniture for builders, designers, architects and commercial clients. Items are inspected before arrival, blanket wrapped in transit, and we protect floors and door jambs in your home.
- Moving boxes and supplies: Boxes and packing supplies for sale at a fair price.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're based in Georgetown and serve Cedar Park, Taylor, Hutto, Creedmore, Buda, Lakeway, Round Rock, San Marcos, Kyle, Dripping Springs, Austin and Elgin.

Q: Can you move me somewhere else in Texas?
A: Yes. We work locally, but we also handle full service relocation end to end anywhere in the State of Texas, including Houston, Dallas/Fort Worth and San Antonio.

Q: How do you put together an estimate?
A: Our customer care agents estimate the move based on your description. If needed, an agent will come out to your place and give you a quote in person.
